description.value: Outbound Station is a quick-dine craft burger shop and café on the Sea-to-Sky Highway in Britannia Beach, positioned squarely on one of BC's most popular cycling corridors between Vancouver and Squamish. The kitchen serves handcrafted burgers alongside specialty espresso drinks, hot chocolate, and matcha lattes, with a stated mission to 'fuel your adventure' for travellers heading in or returning from the mountains. A rewards program and online ordering round out a setup clearly aimed at road and outdoor users looking for a quality, efficient stop.
